items.ruling: Activity opened from the group menu keeps the group frame, with a back link
evidence: Menu > Activity → /activity, header 'Groups | THURSDAY WHIST', back button 'Standings' (from Standings) / 'Sessions' (from Sessions); tapping it → /
items.notes: The group tab bar stays (Standings/Sessions/Players/Admin), none highlighted. The feed still includes notes from Family Table under the Thursday Whist header (see new finding v4-4).

items.ruling: Menu gets 'My stats & account' from anywhere, with a back link
evidence: From /history: Menu > 'My stats & account' → /profile/global with back button 'Sessions' → /history

items.ruling: After a discard, 'Same players' offers the last PLAYED table; Redeal is a second smaller option naming the four
evidence: After discarding round 6 (Maya, Omer, Rachel, אבי): '[8] Same players as last round — Dan bids first' + '[9] Redeal — Maya, Omer, Rachel, אבי'; Same players → bidding 1 Dan 2 נועה 3 יוסי 4 Maya (round 5's table)
After discarding a round whose table = last played table, only 'Same players' is shown (no duplicate Redeal)
New session, first round discarded: 'Redeal — שלומי 2, Maya, Dan, נועה' offered and reproduced the table

items.ruling: One player order for a round everywhere: seat order; trump winner and first bidder marked, never moved
evidence: Round 4 (trump winner נועה in seat 4): typed 3,2,1,7 on empty rows top-to-bottom → יוסי 3, Maya 2, Dan 1, נועה 7 (each on the row typed)

Round 5 seat order Maya, Dan, נועה, יוסי; tapped Dan as first bidder → Dan stays row 2 with 'first bid'; trump winner נועה (seat 3) stays row 3; tricks 5,5,1,2 typed top-to-bottom → Maya 5 (−10), Dan 5 (+35), נועה 1 (−20), יוסי 2 (+14); saved card and round page list the same order and the same scores

Original scenario replayed (Dan 6, Omer 1, Rachel 3 trump ♥, אבי 0; tricks 5,6,2,0): Dan −10, Omer −50, Rachel −10, אבי +50; saved card identical, standings sum matched (closed 'Verifier night' totals נועה +61, Maya +33, Dan +9, שלומי 2 −94 = sum of the three cards)
items.notes: Order and stored scores match on every screen. Two side-issues: the first-bidder mark is not shown on the round card, round page or Edit round (v4-3); the keypad does not auto-advance while the running total is over 13, so re-typing a full column top-to-bottom can overwrite the previous row (v4-1). Neither puts a value on a row other than the highlighted one.

items.ruling: Visible warning in the dock when the marked winner's bid is below the top bid, also at lock time; locking allowed
evidence: (alert) נועה bid 3 — the top bid was 6 (Maya). Is נועה really the trump winner?
(alert) Rachel bid 3 — the top bid was 6 (Dan). Is Rachel really the trump winner?
Lock bids enabled and worked; warning also shown in Edit round; not shown when the winner ties the top bid (Dan 4 / נועה 4)
items.notes: At 320x568 the dock with the warning leaves room for one player row (known minors newcomer-5 / visual-designer-13, slightly worse with the extra line).

items.ruling: 409 with open_round_id → 'A round was just started on another phone with <names>' + Open that round / Back to session
evidence: alertdialog 'A round was just started on another phone' — 'It was started with Omer, Rachel, אבי and נועה. The table you picked was not started.' [Open that round] [Back to session]
Same via the session page's 'Same players' shortcut
items.notes: When the other phone started the identical table the text still says 'The table you picked was not started' (v4-2).

items.ruling: Anonymous switch warns before posting, to everyone incl. admins
evidence: Switch on → 'Anonymous notes can't be deleted later — not even by you. A group admin can remove one.' (as Maya, admin, and as Dan, player)
items.notes: Text appears only after the switch is turned on, which is still before posting.

items.ruling: Gone group → 'This group was deleted' + Your groups; one-time notice on Your groups
evidence: '# This group was deleted / A group admin deleted it. Nobody can open it any more. / [Your groups]'
(alert) Family Table was deleted by a group admin. Nobody can open it any more, and its rounds no longer count in your totals.
After reload the notice is gone (one-time)

items.ruling: Hebrew name ending in a digit separated from seat number
evidence: Seat number in its own badge; name 'שלומי 2' renders as one RTL unit

items.ruling: Resume on group card opens the round in play
'Saved' confirmed after Save round / Save changes
items.notes: The 'Round 3 saved' note is still on screen after Close session (v4-5).

items.ruling: Edit of a round deleted meanwhile → 'This round was deleted' with way back; Save disabled
evidence: '# This round was deleted / It was deleted on another phone while you were editing it. Your changes were not saved. / [Back to session]' — Save changes gone

cross_cutting.overflow: No horizontal overflow (clientWidth == scrollWidth, no element past the right edge) at 320, 390 and 1440 on /home, / (Standings), /history, /session/:id, bidding, results, a scored /round/:id, /profile, /player/:id, /activity, /profile/global, /admin, /about, /rules, /login, /register, /join?code=… (shots x-small_*.png).
cross_cutting.console: Only expected 4xx: 409 startRound (race), 404 getGroupData group_deleted, 404 updateRound (deleted round), 401 User/me when signed out. No console errors or exceptions.
cross_cutting.full_night: Verifier night as Maya: round 1 started with שלומי 2 first, discarded, Redeal; R1 scored; R2 with a renege (שלומי 2 −20 −100 = −120) and an off-top trump warning; R3 everyone fell (all 0, 'Everyone fell' tag); closed. Final: נועה +61 winner, Maya +33, Dan +9, שלומי 2 −94, '3 rounds played · 1 cancelled (everyone fell)'. Arithmetic checked by hand. Also closed Midweek special. No regressions found.
cross_cutting.environment: Chrome refuses port 5061 (net::ERR_UNSAFE_PORT, it is the SIP-TLS port). All browsing went through a local pass-through proxy on 5072 (HTTP + websocket) in the scratchpad; not an app issue, but the sandbox port should change for future runs.
